sentences.en: Under no circumstances must you swim in the deep river!
sentences.zh: 在任何情况下你都不得在深河里游泳!

sentences.en: It was a poor choice of words under the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，那句话说得很不合适。

sentences.en: Under no circumstances will the princess succeed to the throne.
sentences.zh: 公主在任何情况下都无法继承王位。

senses.zh: 条件；环境；状况境况；境遇；（尤指）经济状况命运；客观环境
